note: Factory kill switch. enabled=false pauses production mutations (claims, QA, publish) but keeps safety operations available: --recover, --consistency, writer-lock status/acquire/release, checkpoints, --progress. There is NO scheduled/AI cron anywhere in this repository (test_no_cron_anywhere enforces it), so the former scheduled_runs_enabled flag was dead configuration and has been removed. A paused factory with a pending transaction can always be recovered via --recover.
